comparison_kind: Current compiler actual-candidate strategy comparison, not historical commit replay or isolated one-factor ablation.
timing: kernel: maximum of 16 local main-entry durations; event: same capture TX stream elapsed, includes prepare/dispatch; neither includes host packing/H2D/D2H
notes: All seven measured alternatives are retained; main table selects four useful stages, not a claim that every attempted change improves performance.
Final improvement includes external NCx layout, direct blocked DMA and different tiling; cannot attribute the whole difference to serpentine topology.
Baseline is legal search candidate 37 with no access reuse, not optimization-policy=none.
The none-policy probe compiled but failed the existing one-GEMM-per-Tile harness assertion before no-card/board. No device launch was made for it.
